product_metadata.title: Grace Comfort 2 Piece Solid Purple Sheer Panel Curtain Set 60" X 84" Window Treatment
features: 2 panels included. Each panel is 60" x 84" (152cm x 213")
These Sheer Panels are 1.5 inch Rod Pocket panels
Grace Comfort Allows natural light to flow through the room
description: The Grace sheer voile fabric of this window panel will hang elegantly from any window. It provides privacy to any room without blocking sunlight, and it's designed with a rod pocket to allow for easy hanging. The understated elegance of these sheer panels in purple will create a beautiful look in any room of the house. Its gentle style is enhanced as light filters through it, adding the perfect finishing touch to your decor.
